decisions.reason: Requiring the public total-mints statistic to match completed mints does not change referral-leaderboard count accuracy.
The source separately reports personal reward-summary results, but the source modification concerns only the public total-mints statistic and does not change the dashboard reward fields.
An aggregate total-mints counter and the user's owned-NFT listing are independently valid behaviors; the source does not change the listing requirement.
The public total-mints accuracy rule does not alter the requirement for accurate referrals, tickets, and earnings on an individual NFT detail view.
The source decision concerns an aggregate mint statistic and does not change the NFT metadata ticket-counter attributes.
Metadata and asset endpoint resolution is unaffected by how the platform displays its aggregate count of completed mints.
The total-mints statistic does not change NFT image or information presentation in wallets, dashboards, or detail views.
The landing-page book-cover placement, size, and visibility requirements are independent of the platform's total-mints statistic.
The source does not revise any About-page copy or resolve its existing reward-delivery ambiguity.
Correcting the meaning of the total-mints statistic does not change the current or conditional future project names.
The source reports a platform-statistics issue but does not direct any FAQ copy change.
The public total-mints accuracy requirement does not alter the hero headline, mechanics preview, CTA, emphasis, or layout.
